source: AWS public review sceneDescriptions, falling back to task.scene_i18n; no task bug descriptions or rubrics

description.en: An open-air subway entrance with benches, bins and station access routes. No interactive objects.
description.zh: 露天的地铁入口，设有长椅、垃圾桶和进站通道。无可交互物体。

description.en: A subway waiting area with benches, vending machines and escalators. Some tasks include an interactive bench.
description.zh: 地铁候车区，设有长椅、自动售货机和自动扶梯。部分任务中的长椅可交互。

description.en: A platform beside the trains, with a walkway, benches and bins. No interactive objects.
description.zh: 紧邻列车的站台，设有步行通道、长椅和垃圾桶。无可交互物体。

description.en: A living room with seating, a television and plants, together with the house’s entrance passage and front porch. No interactive objects.
description.zh: 场景包括客厅、房屋入口通道及屋外前廊。客厅内有座椅、电视和植物。无可交互物体。

description.en: A kitchen and dining area with a refrigerator, table, chairs and tableware. Interactive object: cup.
description.zh: 厨房与餐厅，设有冰箱、餐桌、座椅和餐具。可交互物体：杯子。

description.en: A bedroom with an adjoining bathroom. Interactive objects: the bedroom door and the brown wardrobe by the window.
description.zh: 这是一个带有浴室的卧室。可交互物体是卧室门和窗边的棕色衣柜。

description.en: A rear courtyard with bins, boxes and building entrances.
description.zh: 后巷庭院，分布着垃圾桶、纸箱和建筑出入口。

description.en: A shopfront street with outdoor seating, mailboxes and trees.
description.zh: 店面街区，设有露天桌椅、邮箱和街边树木。

description.en: A city intersection with surrounding shops.
description.zh: 两侧有店铺的城市路口。

description.en: A service lane beside buildings, with trees, fences and dumpsters.
description.zh: 建筑侧面的服务巷，分布着树木、围栏和垃圾箱。

description.en: A market street in an ancient Chinese city, lined with wooden stalls, tables and paper umbrellas. Interactive object: the wicker basket on the ground, which moves a short distance along the ground after a gentle push and then stops.
description.zh: 这是一条中国古代城市的集市街道，两侧摆有木制摊位、桌子和纸伞。可交互物体是地上的藤筐，轻推后会沿地面移动一小段，然后停下。

description.en: A tea house in an ancient Chinese city, furnished with wooden tables, benches and hanging lanterns. Its fixed furnishings surround the room and entrance passage.
description.zh: 这是一间中国古代城市的茶馆，摆有木桌、长凳，挂有灯笼。家具与灯笼为固定陈设，室内与入口之间留有通道。

description.en: A residence entrance in an ancient Chinese city, with stone lions, hanging lanterns and two wooden door leaves, one open and one closed. The decorations are fixed, and the two door leaves open and close independently.
description.zh: 这是中国古代城市的一处宅院入口，设有石狮、悬挂灯笼和两扇木门，初始一开一关。石狮与灯笼为固定陈设，两扇木门可以分别开关。

description.en: A factory hall with an assembly line, lockers, boxes and chairs. No interactive objects.
description.zh: 工厂车间，设有装配线、储物柜、纸箱和座椅。无可交互物体。

description.en: A vehicle testing and loading area with equipment, rails, bumpers and metal drums. No interactive objects.
description.zh: 车辆测试与装卸区，设有设备、轨道、防撞设施和金属桶。无可交互物体。

description.en: A control room overlooking the factory floor, with lighting, monitoring consoles, chairs and a coffee table.
description.zh: 俯瞰工厂车间的控制室，设有照明、监控控制台、座椅和茶几。

description.en: An Australian bush road bend with wire fences, trees, fallen logs, rocks and wildlife signs. No interactive objects.
description.zh: 澳大利亚乡间弯道，两侧有铁丝网、树木、倒木、岩石和野生动物警示牌。无可交互物体。

description.en: An Australian country road with signs, trees, fallen logs and fences. No interactive objects.
description.zh: 澳大利亚乡间公路，路边有标牌、树木、倒木和围栏。无可交互物体。

description.en: An Australian creek canyon with rocks, fallen logs and trees. No interactive objects.
description.zh: 澳大利亚溪谷林地，分布着岩石、倒木和树木。无可交互物体。

description.en: A medieval village market with wooden stalls, benches, barrels and grain sacks. Interactive object: basket.
description.zh: 中世纪村庄集市，摆有木制摊位、长凳、木桶和粮食麻袋。可交互物体：篮筐。

description.en: A medieval windmill courtyard with a tower, wooden cart and workshop supplies. No interactive objects.
description.zh: 中世纪风车庭院，旁边有塔楼、木推车和工坊物料。无可交互物体。

description.en: An atrium with columns, drapes, stone planters and aisles. No interactive objects.
description.zh: 设有柱廊、帷幔、石花盆和通道的中庭。无可交互物体。

description.en: A woodland cottage with a pond, stone paths, trees and outdoor furniture. No interactive objects.
description.zh: 林间小屋，周围有池塘、石径、树木和户外家具。无可交互物体。

description.en: An airfield with parked cars, barriers, barrels, crates and workshop equipment. No interactive objects.
description.zh: 机场场地，停放着汽车，周围有路障、油桶、箱子和维修设备。无可交互物体。

description.en: A two-storey home with a kitchen, living room, dining room and upstairs bedrooms. No interactive objects.
description.zh: 双层住宅，设有厨房、客厅、餐厅和楼上卧室。无可交互物体。

description.en: A shallow-water reef with rocks, coral and fish. No interactive objects.
description.zh: 分布着岩石、珊瑚和鱼群的浅水礁区。无可交互物体。

description.en: Grassland with pine trees, shrubs and boulders.
description.zh: 分布着松树、灌木和岩石的荒野草地。
